test_jotaibench_size: test the JotaiBench dataset size assertion to verify it contains 18761 benchmarks
test_missing_benchmark_name: test that JotaiBenchDataset raises LookupError when no benchmark name is specified in the URI
test_jotaibench_random_select: test random benchmark selection from JotaiBenchDataset by iterating benchmark URIs and writing source files
run_jotaibench_tests: run the JotaiBench dataset test suite using pytest with the llvm test plugin
review_jotaibench_dataset_fixture: review the JotaiBenchDataset pytest fixture that creates an llvm-v0 environment and retrieves the jotaibench-v0 dataset
